				entry_container = "mod1440_records_adv_row"
			}

				array = mod1440_ev_subjects
				change_scope = yes
				entry_container = "mod1440_records_sub_row"

		}

		properties = {
			gv_tab_0 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_0
			}
			gv_tab_1 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_1
			}
			gv_tab_2 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_2

			}

				frame = mod1440_gv_pop_1
			}
			gv_p_2_bar = {
				frame = mod1440_gv_pop_2
			}
			gv_p_3_bar = {
				frame = mod1440_gv_pop_3
			}
		}

		effects = {
			gv_tab_0_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			gv_tab_1_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			gv_tab_2_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			gv_tab_3_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			gv_close_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 0 }
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			gv_leader_since_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 0 }
			}
			gv_leader_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 1 }
			}
			gv_next_visible = {
				check_variable = { days_until_next_election > -1 }
			}
			gv_next_none_visible = {
				check_variable = { days_until_next_election < 0 }
			}
			gv_adv_none_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv^num < 1 }
			}
			gv_adv_row_since_visible = {
				check_variable = { v = 0 }
			}
			gv_adv_row_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { v = 1 }
			}
			gv_adv_row_stripe_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_odd^i = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_0_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_0_none_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }
			}
			gv_of_0_since_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_old = 0 }
			}
			gv_of_0_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_old = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_1_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_1_none_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } }
			}
			gv_of_1_since_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_old = 0 }
			}
			gv_of_1_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_old = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_2_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_2_none_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 } }
			}
			gv_of_2_since_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_old = 0 }
			}
			gv_of_2_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_old = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_3_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 }
			}
			gv_of_3_none_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 } }

			gv_of_3_since_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_old = 0 }

			check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_old = 1 }

			gv_hc_none_visible = {

			}

			gv_hc_row_since_old_visible = {

			gv_hc_row_stripe_visible = {

			gv_faction_visible = {
				is_in_faction = yes
			}
			gv_faction_none_visible = {
				is_in_faction = no
			}
			gv_sub_none_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_ev_subjects^num < 1 }
			}

			always = no
		}
	}

	mod1440_records_wr = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mod1440_records_wr"

		visible = {
			check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 }
		}

		dynamic_lists = {
			wr_now_grid = {
				array = mod1440_wr_surr
				entry_container = "mod1440_records_war_row"
			}
			wr_old_grid = {
				array = mod1440_wo_days
				entry_container = "mod1440_records_past_war_row"
			}
		}

		properties = {
			wr_tab_0 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_0
			}
			wr_tab_1 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_1
			}
			wr_tab_2 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_2
			}
			wr_tab_3 = {
				frame = mod1440_rec_tab_3
			}
			wr_row_bar = {
				frame = v
			}
		}

		effects = {
			wr_tab_0_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			wr_tab_1_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			wr_tab_2_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			wr_tab_3_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 }
				mod1440_rec_show = yes
			}
			wr_close_click = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 0 }
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			wr_now_none_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_wr_enemy^num < 1 }
			}
			wr_old_none_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_wo_enemy^num < 1 }
			}
			wr_row_stripe_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_odd^i = 1 }
			}
			wr_row_since_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_old^i = 1 } }
			}
			wr_row_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_wr_old^i = 1 }
			}
			wr_row_outcome_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^i > 0 }
			}
			wo_row_stripe_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_odd^i = 1 }
			}
			wo_row_since_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_old^i = 1 } }
			}
			wo_row_since_old_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_wo_old^i = 1 }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}

	mod1440_records_handle = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mod1440_records_handle"
		parent_window_token = top_bar

		visible = {
			always = yes
		}

		effects = {
			rec_toggle_click = {
				mod1440_ev_init = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 0 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } }
					mod1440_rec_show = yes
				}
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}

	mod1440_state_card = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		window_name = "mod1440_state_card"
		parent_window_token = selected_state_view

		visible = {
			is_controlled_by = ROOT
		}

		effects = {
			sc_cite_click = {
				set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
				every_state_division = {
					limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
					add_history_entry = {
						key = mod1440_hn_cited
						subject = "Citation"
						allow = yes
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited = hn_n }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited_day = global.num_days }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { hn_n > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_cited }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 20 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = THIS }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
					ROOT = {
						mod1440_tr_add = yes
						add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
					}
				}
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			sc_taken_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 }
			}
			sc_untaken_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day < 1 }
			}
			sc_cite_visible = {
				has_dlc = "By Blood Alone"
			}
			sc_cited_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited_day = global.num_days }
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited > 0 }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}
}
